notes: Redevelopment Agency minutes 1982-87 (six volumes). Curated onto pages that exist: Western Addition A-2 rehabilitation sales, Tenderloin Section 8 financing, the Goodman Building's emptying, the JCCCNC's opening, the Bush Street Temple proposals, Coleridge Park Homes.

coverage.remaining: Not placed or skipped: Yerba Buena Center demolitions of 1983 (355 Fourth Street, 87-97 Third/694-698 Mission, 109-11 Third, and a 676-678 Mission whose site is ambiguous against the standing 678 Mission); Eddy Place Associates' parcel on Eddy between Franklin and Van Ness; the Children's Hospital flats moved to Parcel 1126-F on Ellis between Divisadero and Broderick (no address); 1151 Webster (no page); 906 Steiner and 1801 Turk (sales to private people only). Buyers who are private people are not named.
